name: philenews.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But links must have discernible text.
lesson: Give every link text that says where it goes. An icon alone needs an aria-label.
summary: www.philenews.com scores 63 out of 100 (D). 8 checks fail now, 28 are at risk, and 27 pass. Fix first: tracking starts before the visitor chooses.

fix.title: Tracking starts before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: A cookie banner was showing. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Meta Pixel (1 request), Google Analytics (1 request), and cookies _ga, _gid, _gat.
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 117 elements on /, /kipros/, /kosmos/, for example .ig > a[rel="noopener noreferrer"][target="_blank"] and .fb > a[rel="noopener noreferrer"][target="_blank"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

fix.title: 219 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: All touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 101 elements on /, /kipros/, /kosmos/, for example .top-home-left > .master-col.grid-col > .major-article.non.card-wrapper > .card > .pd-sm.no-border-title.card-info > .ca and .pd-sm.no-border-title.card-info > .border.card-details.flex…
fix.fix: Make tap targets at least 24 by 24 px, or leave that much space around them.

fix.title: <li> elements must be contained in a <ul> or <ol>
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 18 elements on /, /kipros/, /kosmos/, for example .footer-nav-col:nth-child(1) > .nav-list-item and .footer-nav-col:nth-child(2) > .nav-list-item. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Put each li inside a ul or ol.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 4 elements on /, /kipros/, /kosmos/, for example .card-grid > .tab-grid-2-3.grid > .grid-more > .grid-more-link > a and #cookiescript_accept. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.
